title: Commercial Credit Account Catch-Up Discount: Amount of the Line
content:
**Accounts receivable desk calculation — the amount of a catch-up prompt-payment discount line on a Commercial Credit Account.**

### 1. The payment and the invoice

1.1 The payment concerned is the payment entry with the latest received date on the account and the invoice concerned is the invoice that entry is applied to; when more than one payment entry carries that latest received date, no catch-up discount is booked under this rule and the catch-up figure is nothing.

1.2 The payment amount is the amount of the payment concerned applied to the invoice concerned, and the invoice total is the total of the invoice concerned.

1.3 What is left open on the invoice is the invoice total less every payment, credit memo, discount line and write-off applied to it, plus every returned payment reversed on it, compared without rounding with the tier's prompt-payment discount percentage of the invoice's merchandise subtotal.

### 2. Invoices this calculation covers

2.1 This rule covers only an invoice dated inside the current term, from its effective date through its expiration date, of the customer's live Contract Pricing Agreement, meaning its one agreement whose status is active or renewal pending. Both the effective date and the expiration date are inside the term.

2.2 For a payment on an invoice within this rule's scope the prompt-payment discount it earns is worked out under this rule, in place of the tier's prompt-payment discount percentage applied to the merchandise subtotal of the invoice it pays; every other invoice remains under the base cash-discount rule, which applies that percentage to the merchandise subtotal, and freight and sales tax never earn a discount.

### 3. The figure for an invoice within the scope

3.1 The prompt-payment discount is the discount rate applied once to the merchandise the payment pays for, counted in the proportion that the discountable merchandise bears to the invoice's merchandise subtotal, rounded to the nearest cent only on that final figure.

3.2 The discount rate is the tier's prompt-payment discount percentage, the discountable merchandise is the merchandise subtotal of the invoice the payment is applied to, never its freight or sales tax, and the merchandise the payment pays for is the whole of that merchandise subtotal.

3.3 Every share of the discount rate this rule sets multiplies the tier's percentage, and the rate so reached is applied once; an invoice with no merchandise earns nothing.

### 4. The figure for every other invoice

For every other invoice, including any invoice of a customer with no live agreement or with more than one, the catch-up line carries exactly the base cash-discount rule's figure: the tier's prompt-payment discount percentage of the invoice's merchandise subtotal when the payment leaves open no more than that discount, that figure in the proportion of the payment to the invoice total for a payment leaving more open on a tier allowing partial-payment discounts, and nothing for such a payment on any other tier or for an invoice billed under an agreement on a cash-discount-excluded pricing tier whose status is active on the invoice date, which the records show as the customer's live agreement recorded on such a tier with status active, the only agreement status and tier the records hold, rounded to the nearest cent.

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Tier percentage 1 percent; invoice merchandise 2000.00, freight 100.00, sales tax 140.00, invoice total 2240.00.

| Case | Figure |
|---|---|
| invoice within the scope, payment 2220.00 (leaves 20.00 open) | 1 percent of 2000.00, in the proportion 2000.00 to 2000.00: 20.00 |
| invoice outside the scope, payment 2220.00 (leaves 20.00 open, no more than the 20.00 discount) | 20.00 |
| invoice outside the scope, payment 1120.00 on a tier allowing partial-payment discounts | 20.00 in the proportion 1120.00 to 2240.00: 10.00 |
| invoice outside the scope, payment 1120.00 on a tier not allowing them | nothing |
| two payment entries share the latest received date | nothing |
